rows.grounds: compound adjective describing the location of the recitation; lalāṭa (forehead) + varṇa (syllable) + rāśi (mass) + stha (situated)
object of the action expressed by the gerund
absolutive indicating completion of the recitation prior to the implied next step
vocative compound addressing the recipient; sura (god) + arcita (worshipped)

items.question: What specific recitation practice must the firmly resolved practitioner complete, O god-worshipped one?
premises: The instruction is addressed to one worshipped by the gods.
A hundred-thousand repetitions are to be performed.
These repetitions are situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead.
items.inference: The firmly resolved practitioner must complete a hundred-thousand recitations focused on the syllable-mass located on the forehead.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the syllable-mass on the forehead is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: O you worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred thousand repetitions situated in the mass of syllables on the forehead...
